csv_array_encoding: JSON array inside an RFC 4180 quoted field
admin_code_type: string; leading zeros preserved; source-specific, not ISO subdivision codes
parent_relationship: Nearest unique administrative ancestor from exact full source-code tuple; null on unresolved references. Country membership remains country_id.
coordinates: GeoNames WGS84 point coordinates; not boundary polygons or premises
population: Source value; 0 may mean unknown; not a current census claim
name_language: und: source name and alias fields are not language-tagged; ASCII is not an English translation
source_modified_date: GeoNames row modification date; not administrative legal effective date
secondary_country_codes: Uninterpreted GeoNames cc2 field, not additional country membership
source_code: Country plus available admin codes for ADM1-ADM4; GeoNames ID otherwise
not_included: official legal municipal status for GeoNames rows
